task.description: REWORK ITERATION 1: SECURITY-REVIEWER FAILed Step 2c with a BLOCKER on INV-1 (docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md), root-caused in this design. Read handoffs/WF02-REQ037-20260817/step-02c-security-reviewer.json's full result.summary and result.issues[0] for the complete finding before touching the design doc. Summary: insert_review/2's design (lib/letflow/design/promotion_review_state_machine.md lines ~337-339) explicitly specifies that attrs.tenant_id is set from the caller-supplied plan.target_tenant_id while opts[:prefix] is taken as an independently-trusted value with nothing tying the two together -- this is exactly the rejected option (a) from docs/migration/decisions/0003-ecto-schema-strategy.md's 2026-08-17 write-time tenant_id-derivation addendum. The addendum's own accepted resolution is to derive/validate tenant_id from opts[:prefix] via Letflow.TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 (already shipped, built for REQ-025 -- read that function's actual signature/behavior directly, don't assume). Read the addendum in docs/migration/decisions/0003-ecto-schema-strategy.md in full to understand exactly what it requires. Revise ONLY the insert_review/2 section of the design (§2.3) to close this gap: either (a) derive tenant_id internally from opts[:prefix] via tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 rather than trusting plan.target_tenant_id at all, or (b) validate that plan.target_tenant_id matches the tenant_id derived from opts[:prefix] and return an explicit error (name the atom) on mismatch before any insert -- pick whichever the addendum actually calls for (read it, don't guess), and state your reasoning. The other 5 transition functions were confirmed by SECURITY-REVIEWER to be safe (they never touch the tenant_id column, only read via prefix-scoped Repo.get) -- do not unnecessarily change them, but do double check them explicitly against the addendum for completeness in your revised doc. promote_definition/3's own design is otherwise unaffected -- do not revise it unless the insert_review/2 fix changes what it can trust from review.tenant_id.
acceptance_criteria: Revised design's insert_review/2 satisfies the 2026-08-17 write-time tenant_id-derivation addendum to Decision 0003 -- explicitly cite which of the addendum's accepted resolutions you applied and why
No other function's design changed unless the insert_review/2 fix requires it, and any such change is called out explicitly
The revision is scoped to the design doc only -- do not touch implementation files (ELIXIR-DEV re-implements after this passes validation again)

Explicitly re-verify the other 5 transition functions against the addendum in the revised doc, even though SECURITY-REVIEWER already confirmed them safe, so the doc's own reasoning is complete and self-contained
